Guild Info

Mark of the Wolves is a brand new Guild (Or Posse) Founded by Pharque and LegendRunner. We are not recruiting, instead we only invite the best level 100's we know. Our goal is to Make a Farm and PvP friendly enviroment. That being said, we are active in both PvE and PvP.

Latest News
